```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
source("../_common.R")

kareem_career <- tibble(
  decade = c("1970s", "1980s"),
  ppg = c(27.2, 21.5),
  rpg = c(14.2, 7.5),
  championships = c(1, 5)
)

kareem_by_age <- tibble(
  age = c(22, 25, 28, 31, 34, 37, 40),
  ppg = c(28.8, 30.2, 26.2, 24.8, 21.5, 17.5, 10.1)
)

all_time_scorers <- tibble(
  player = c("LeBron James", "Kareem Abdul-Jabbar", "Karl Malone", "Kobe Bryant", "Michael Jordan"),
  points = c(40474, 38387, 36928, 33643, 32292)
)
```

> *"One man can be a crucial ingredient on a team, but one man cannot make a team."* – Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

## Mastery of a Shot

The skyhook was basketball's most unblockable shot. Released from a position where defenders simply couldn't reach it, Kareem's signature move carried him for 20 NBA seasons—the longest career of excellence the league had ever seen.

**Kareem didn't just play the game. He perfected one aspect of it so thoroughly that it became his alone.**

## The Shot That Couldn't Be Stopped

The skyhook wasn't natural—it was engineered. Kareem practiced it obsessively, understanding that a single, perfected weapon could be more valuable than a diverse but average arsenal.

```{r scoring-timeline, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Kareem maintained scoring production deep into his late 30s"

highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "spline") %>%
  hc_title(text = "Kareem's Scoring by Age") %>%
  hc_subtitle(text = "Elite production well past typical prime years") %>%
  hc_xAxis(categories = kareem_by_age$age, title = list(text = "Age")) %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Points Per Game"), min = 0, max = 35) %>%
  hc_add_series(name = "PPG", data = kareem_by_age$ppg, color = "#552583") %>%
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_flatdark())
```

## The Longevity of Greatness

Kareem won championships in the 1970s and 1980s. He was Finals MVP at age 38. His career spanned eras, teammates, and playing styles—and he adapted to all of them.

```{r all-time-scoring, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Kareem held the all-time scoring record for 39 years"

highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "bar") %>%
  hc_title(text = "All-Time NBA Scoring Leaders") %>%
  hc_xAxis(categories = all_time_scorers$player) %>%
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Career Points")) %>%
  hc_add_series(
    name = "Points",
    data = all_time_scorers$points,
    colorByPoint = TRUE,
    colors = c("#860038", "#552583", "#002B5C", "#552583", "#CE1141")
  ) %>%
  hc_tooltip(pointFormat = "<b>{point.y:,.0f} points</b>") %>%
  hc_add_theme(hc_theme_flatdark())
```

| Achievement | Value |
|------------|-------|
| Career Points | 38,387 |
| Championships | 6 |
| MVP Awards | 6 (Record) |
| Finals MVPs | 2 |
| All-Star Games | 19 |
| Seasons Played | 20 |

## The Infinite Game

Kareem understood that basketball careers are finite, but mastery is eternal. By perfecting the skyhook and maintaining his body, he extended his excellence far beyond what anyone thought possible.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Lessons from Kareem's Infinite Game

1. **Perfect one thing** - The skyhook alone made him unstoppable
2. **Longevity is a strategy** - Taking care of his body extended his prime
3. **Adapt across eras** - He won championships in two different decades
4. **Play the long game** - His approach was sustainable, not flashy
:::
